mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (member_id, type, title, content, link_url, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_read = false
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = true WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND is_read = false
